name: Sakakibara Ayumu
source:
She is a girl who is full of maidenly charm, a good girl who is very attentive. She is persistent in order to overcome her own difficulties.

She has no knowledge or skill when it comes to sex, however, she will not hesitate to have sex if it makes her partner happy. She is a person who fundamentally likes to please others.

She worries that her parents are too laidback, she tries her best everyday to better herself.
